creature.description:
Big Yrame shifts her weight between hind and forelegs. She shakes a storm of rust dander from the tines of her great horns, and she blows a halo of freezing air from her rime-veined hands.
{{C|-----}}
Loved by {{C|the Fellowship of Wardens}}.

Admired by {{C|the villagers of Joppa}} for defending their village.

Disliked by {{C|the villagers of Tuwan}} for disparaging a famous poet.

Disliked by {{C|trees}} for eating one of their young.

race.description: Human humanoid anatomy: one torso, head and back; two arms and hands; a paired-feet group. Physical mutations require their actual body variant.

donor.role: Actual Biotech directional head-attachment convention and VTE replacement textures: pair front/back, overlapping single profile silhouette and north behind head. Small donor knobs do not replace Qud great grooved horns; donor gene/node logic is not ported.

design: One pair of large tapered grooved bone horns, symmetric in front/back. East projects near/far roots onto same profile crown, with far horn behind original head and near horn above it; no frontal pair pasted onto profile. Curvature and unseen rear surfaces are authored interpretation of the sparse original and pair description.

palette.resolution: TileColor w overrides ColorString y; W is source gold detail, not white. Neutral production textures and separate groove/highlight detail.

scope: Separate mutation/natural-equipment overlay on reusable unmutated female body. Never bake horns, extra legs, freezing hands or named Big morphology into ordinary body. This authoring overlay does not implement a generalized mutation framework.
native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation, integrated natural Head288/0 attachment, headgear precedence, physical-frame mapping and Yrame full mutation/outfit assembly.
